name: @aobplatform/web
description: Web surfaces — practice console (M12), patient/assignor portal (M8), and public tester front end (M4). Next.js + Radix, WCAG 2.2 AA on all patient-facing pages, every user-facing string in the string table (REQ-LANG-01).

scripts.//e2e:kiosk: DELIBERATELY NOT `test:e2e`: root `npm run test:e2e` fans out across workspaces and CI has no core or web server running. This one needs both (core on 3001, web on 3100) and a staged waiting patient.
scripts.//e2e:service-description: Needs core on 3001, web on 3100, and E2E_PRACTICE_USER / E2E_PRACTICE_PASSWORD for the dev realm — the endpoint refuses an unattributed request by design, so the suite skips without them.
